name: Plugin Card UI
description: DOM structure, interactions, and visual states for the PluginCard widget.

dom.style: position: absolute; left/top/width/height set by constructor options

elements.card-header: .card-header — header bar containing title area and control buttons
elements.card-controls: .card-controls — container for minimize, fit-viewport, and terminate buttons
elements.card-btn-minimize: .card-btn.card-btn-minimize — minimize button with SVG horizontal line icon
elements.card-btn-fitview: .card-btn.card-btn-fitview — fit-viewport button with SVG viewport arrows icon
elements.card-btn-terminate: .card-btn.card-btn-terminate — terminate button with SVG X icon

interactions.name: drag_start
interactions.gesture: mousemove on document + mouseup on document
interactions.action: screenX = snap(worldRawX) * scale + panX; screenY = snap(worldRawY) * scale + panY; fire onDragMove; on mouseup fire onDragEnd(worldX, worldY)

interactions.name: resize_east
interactions.gesture: mousemove on document + mouseup on document
interactions.action: newW = Math.max(280, snap(startW + dw/scale)); fire onResizeEnd on mouseup

interactions.name: resize_south
interactions.gesture: mousemove on document + mouseup on document
interactions.action: newH = Math.max(280, snap(startH + dh/scale)); fire onResizeEnd on mouseup

interactions.name: resize_southeast
interactions.gesture: mousemove on document + mouseup on document
interactions.action: Resize both width and height; newW = Math.max(280, snap(startW + dw/scale)); newH = Math.max(280, snap(startH + dh/scale)); fire onResizeEnd on mouseup

interactions.name: header_doubleclick
interactions.propagation: Ignored if click target is within .card-controls

states.default: Card visible at configured position with draggable header, resize handles, and control buttons.
states.dragging: Card following cursor with transition: none, cursor: grabbing on document. Position snaps to 28px grid.
states.resizing: Card width/height updating in real-time as edge handles are dragged. Minimum dimensions enforced at 280px.
states.closed: Card removed from DOM via remove() method, onDestroy callback fired.

rendering.card-title-canvas: Rendered using @chenglou/pretext prepareWithSegments() and layoutWithLines() with device pixel ratio scaling. Font: 700 13px 'Space Mono'. Color from --primary CSS custom property.
